INSERT INTO server_bans (server_id, user_id, banned_by, reason, expires_at)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
        ON CONFLICT (server_id, user_id)
        DO UPDATE SET
            banned_by = EXCLUDED.banned_by,
            reason = EXCLUDED.reason,
            expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
            created_at = NOW()
